title: Rental Tier Entry Gates and Tier Ranking
content:
Each tier of Rental Property Service Contracts is open only to a property inside its entry gate. Every tier requires a residential property that is rented or held for rent. The rank orders the tiers from lowest to highest.

| Rank | Tier | Property types | Dwelling units | Maximum square footage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bridgewell Rental Appliance | single-family home, townhome, condominium | exactly 1 | 9999 |
| 2 | Bridgewell Rental Systems | single-family home, townhome, condominium | exactly 1 | 9999 |
| 3 | Bridgewell Rental Combo | single-family home, townhome, condominium | exactly 1 | 9999 |
| 4 | Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | single-family home, townhome, condominium | exactly 1 | 9999 |
| 5 | Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | multi-unit building | 2 to 4 | no square-footage limit stated |
| 6 | Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | multi-unit building | 2 to 4 | no square-footage limit stated |

## Hypothetical properties against the gates

- A rented condominium of one unit: inside the gate of ranks 1 to 4, outside ranks 5 and 6.
- A rented duplex (multi-unit building, 2 units): inside the gate of ranks 5 and 6 only.
- A five-unit building: outside every tier's gate, since the multi-unit tiers stop at 4 units.
- A single-family home of 9999 square feet held for rent: inside ranks 1 to 4; one of 10000 square feet is outside them.
